author: Nehemiah (in large part)
audience: Jews in Judah after the exile
overview: Nehemiah, a Jewish official in the Persian court, hears that Jerusalem's walls are in ruins. He returns, organises the people, and rebuilds the walls in 52 days despite threats. Ezra reads the law aloud and the people renew their covenant with God.
storyPlace: The last historical events of the Old Testament.
